title: Grilled Squid with Jubilant Glaze
description: A seafood dish featuring grilled squid with a sweet and tangy jubilant glaze, inspired by the flavors of Basque cuisine.

ingredients.name: Jubilant
ingredients.notes: Honey or substitute with maple syrup

ingredients.name: Basque
ingredients.notes: Red wine vinegar or substitute with apple cider vinegar

instructions: Rinse squid and pat dry with paper towels.
Thread squid onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush squid with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill squid for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine jubilant and basque in a small saucepan.
Bring mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce heat to low and let sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Brush sauce onto grilled squid during last minute of cooking.
Serve squid hot, garnished with additional jubilant if desired.
